name: WP Rankify – AI SEO, Schema JSON-LD & AI Content Optimizer
author: muenchmedia

sections.description:
Your content is being graded. By Google. By AI crawlers. By ChatGPT.

The question is: does it pass?

WP Rankify gives you an honest answer — with a weighted score across four categories, concrete action items, auto-generated Schema.org markup, a rule-based meta description generator, and an AI-powered topic analysis that shows exactly what your article is still missing.

No vanity score. Just what actually matters.

✅ Weighted AI Readiness Score – 4 categories, 0–100 points, right inside the WordPress editor
✅ Compatible with Yoast, RankMath & AIOSEO – automatic detection, zero conflicts
✅ E-E-A-T analysis – checks author authority, job title, biography and SameAs links
✅ Schema.org Person + Article – automatic JSON-LD markup generated from your author profile
✅ AI topic analysis – missing subtopics, unanswered questions, related search queries
✅ Meta description generator – 4 optimized variants, rule-based, no API key required
✅ Internal linking – finds relevant articles and links them automatically
✅ Score presets – YMYL/Expert, Standard Blog, E-Commerce, Custom
✅ Automatic generation of the all-important llms.txt
✅ Dashboard – overview of all posts with scores, filter tabs and top issues
✅ Tracking & Analytics – Google Tag Manager, GA4, Search Console and Meta Pixel
✅ Google Search Console connection in 5 simple steps

🎯 Why This Plugin Is Different

Most SEO plugins measure whether your keyword shows up often enough.

WP Rankify measures whether Google and AI systems trust who you are — and whether your article genuinely covers every topic it should.

That’s the difference between ranking and not ranking after the Helpful Content Update.

📊 The AI Readiness Score

Four weighted categories. No arbitrary points.

✍ Content Quality (35%)
Word count, heading structure, sentence length, readability, lists, FAQ signals — everything Google considers “helpful.”

🏅 E-E-A-T / Authority (30%)
The core of the plugin. Author job title, professional bio, SameAs links (LinkedIn, Instagram, Xing), external sources. Exactly what Google means by “Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness, Trust.”

⚙ Technical SEO (20%)
Featured image, alt text, meta description (compatible with Yoast, RankMath, AIOSEO), title length and CTR signals.

🔗 Internal Linking (15%)
Internal links and content freshness. Because a great article is useless if it’s an island.

Score bands:
* 🟢 75–100: AI-Ready
* 🟡 50–74: Needs Work
* 🔴 0–49: Critical

🧠 AI Topic Analysis (Pro)

The feature no other SEO plugin has.

WP Rankify analyzes your article holistically — not by keywords, but by content. The AI identifies:

  • Missing topics – What do readers of this article actually expect to find? With priority and reasoning.
  • Unanswered questions – Which concrete questions are left open?
  • Related search queries – What else are people searching for on this topic?
  • Overall assessment – An honest 1-2 sentence evaluation of the article.

No API key required. The AI runs on the WP Rankify server — you only pay for the subscription.

Free: 3 analyses/month. Pro: 50–100 analyses. Agency: unlimited.

🏥 Score Presets For Your Industry

Because a medical website is judged by different standards than a tech blog.

  • YMYL / Expert (medicine, law, finance, consulting) → E-E-A-T weighted 40%
  • Standard Blog (content, news, magazines) → Balanced
  • E-Commerce / Local (shops, restaurants, service providers) → Technical SEO weighted 35%
  • Custom → Set your own weighting via sliders

👤 Expert Profile & Schema.org Person

This is the feature other plugins don’t have.

For each author, you fill in the following on their WordPress profile:

  • Job title (e.g. “Certified Nurse Practitioner”)
  • Professional bio (short summary of their expertise)
  • Practice/expert website
  • SameAs links (social media profiles, industry directories)

The plugin automatically turns this into a complete Schema.org @graph in the <head> of every post — no shortcodes, no manual work.

📝 Meta Description Generator

WP Rankify analyzes your post using rule-based logic and suggests 4 optimized meta descriptions — no API key, no cost:

  • Keyword-focused: main keyword up front, factual and informative
  • Benefit-focused: what’s in it for the reader?
  • Question format: opens with a question to spark curiosity
  • Call to action: clear CTA at the end

Every variant shows character count and a quality score. Apply it with one click directly into Yoast SEO, RankMath or AIOSEO.

🔗 Automatic Internal Linking

One click inserts relevant internal links directly into your text — no manual searching, no copy-paste. WP Rankify finds topically related articles and links the matching keyword automatically.

📈 Dashboard

Your entire site at a glance:

  • Doughnut chart: How many posts are AI-Ready / Need Work / Critical?
  • Radar chart: Average scores by category
  • Filter tabs: Instantly see every post missing an image, meta description, links or an H2
  • Top 3 issues shown directly in the post list — you know exactly what to fix next

🔧 Compatibility

  • ✅ Gutenberg & Classic Editor
  • ✅ Elementor, Divi, Beaver Builder & all page builders
  • ✅ Yoast SEO, RankMath, AIOSEO (automatic detection)
  • ✅ Built-in SEO meta box if no SEO plugin is installed
  • ✅ Advanced Custom Fields (ACF)
  • ✅ Multisite-ready
  • ✅ PHP 7.4+, WordPress 5.8+

💰 Pricing

  • Free: All core features + 3 AI analyses/month – free forever
  • Starter: €2.99/month – 50 AI analyses
  • Pro: €4.99/month – 100 AI analyses
  • Agency: €99/month – unlimited analyses, unlimited domains

All plans cancel anytime. Payment via PayPal.

More info: https://wprankify.de/#pricing

🛣 Roadmap

  • 🌍 Multilingual schema output (hreflang)
  • 👥 Team profile management for agencies
  • ⚡ Analysis caching for large websites

🧩 Installation

  1. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins → Add New and search for: WP Rankify
  2. Install & activate
  3. Go to Tools → WP Rankify
  4. Fill in your Expert Profile under Users → Profile
  5. Open a post and check its AI Readiness Score

Done. No API key required for the score or the meta description generator.

⚙️ Settings

Under Tools → WP Rankify:

  • Choose active post types
  • Select your SEO plugin (auto-detection recommended)
  • Enable Schema.org Article markup
  • Choose a score preset (YMYL / Standard / E-Commerce / Custom)
  • Run a bulk export

Under Users → Profile:

  • Manage job title, professional bio, website & SameAs links

❓ Frequently Asked Questions

Is the plugin completely free?

The core features are entirely free — including the score, meta description generator, dashboard, Schema.org output, and 3 AI analyses per month. For more AI analyses, affordable Pro plans start at €2.99/month.

Do I need an API key?

No. The AI Readiness Score, the meta description generator and the expert profile all work without an API key. The AI topic analysis runs through the WP Rankify server.

What is the AI Readiness Score?

The AI Readiness Score shows, on a scale of 0 to 100, how well your article is set up for AI-driven search such as Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT and Perplexity. It’s based on four weighted categories: content quality, E-E-A-T signals, technical SEO and structured data.

What is E-E-A-T?

E-E-A-T stands for Experience, Expertise, Authoritativeness and Trustworthiness — the four factors Google uses to judge whether an author and a website can be trusted. WP Rankify checks whether your site is sending these signals correctly.

How is this different from Yoast SEO?

Yoast measures keyword density and readability. WP Rankify measures E-E-A-T signals, author authority, missing topics and AI readiness — the things that have actually driven rankings since the Helpful Content Update.

Does the plugin change my frontend design?

No. It only adds structured data inside the <head> — no visible changes to your layout.

How does the AI topic analysis work?

Your article text is sent to the WP Rankify server, analyzed by an AI, and the results are sent back to you. No content is stored permanently.

Is the plugin GDPR-compliant?

Anonymous usage statistics are sent (site URL, PHP version, average scores — no content, no email addresses). This can be disabled on first launch.

Can I use this plugin on client websites?

Yes. The Agency plan covers unlimited domains.

📸 Screenshots

  1. WP Rankify – Readiness Score metabox with category bars and action items
  2. AI topic analysis – missing topics, unanswered questions, related search queries
  3. Meta description generator with 4 variants, right in the editor
  4. Dashboard with doughnut and radar charts plus filter tabs
  5. Expert profile fields in the WordPress user profile
